items.name: ascii-fluid
items.title: ASCII Fluid
items.description: Mouse-trail WebGL fluid background quantized to a clean ASCII brightness ramp - zero deps, theme-aware.

items.name: ascii-logo
items.title: ASCII Logo
items.description: Interactive ASCII wordmark: glyphs shove away from the cursor, then click-cycle through scatter, gravity drop, and reassemble. Zero deps.

items.name: dither-scan
items.title: Dither Scan
items.description: An image that starts as a 1-bit ordered dither. A diagonal scan line sweeps it a set number of times, and each pass sharpens the cells and brings back tone and color until the source is clean.

items.name: dithered-404
items.title: Dithered 404
items.description: Bayer-pixel 404 section: a fireball cursor scorches the glyph, burns it into embers and smoke, then reforms. Optional soft realistic fire.

items.name: folio
items.title: Folio
items.description: The whole page leans back in perspective while you scroll, blurs, then springs flat when you stop.

items.name: gooey-color-picker
items.title: Gooey Color Picker
items.description: A floating color picker with a circular hue wheel, alpha slider, hex field, and motion-powered open/close.

items.name: iso-lattice
items.title: Iso Lattice
items.description: A hex lattice of glowing tiles that builds solid isometric figures, one over the last, from the floor up. Follows light and dark.

items.name: live-orb
items.title: Live Orb
items.description: An evenly lit sphere with two capsule eyes that follow the pointer: white, black, webgl, and custom variants.

items.name: logo-burst
items.title: Logo Burst
items.description: Hair-line tentacles explode from the center, then keep a slow inhale. Follows light and dark.

items.name: mech-keyboard
items.title: Mech Keyboard
items.description: A 75% mechanical keyboard drawn as an isometric illustration in three.js, with ink outlines and a volume knob. Keys press along with your real keyboard, and a recorder spells out the shortcut for onboarding flows.

items.name: phosphor-score
items.title: Phosphor Score
items.description: Vertical sheet music on a CRT phosphor: notes fall, bloom at the playhead, then exit in a flare.

items.name: radiant-lines
items.title: Radiant Lines
items.description: A hyperspace starfield background: colored streaks radiate from the center, with warp speed driven by scroll velocity.

items.name: ring-tower
items.title: Ring Tower
items.description: A tower of tilted bands wrapped in your images. They crawl around, drag to spin, and neighbors counter-turn with the pointer.

items.name: shader-anime-fire
items.title: Shader Anime Fire
items.description: Cel-shaded WebGL flames for landing heroes: tongues lick up from the bottom in flat bands of heat, and the fire reaches for the pointer.

items.name: shader-gradient
items.title: Shader Gradient
items.description: Quiet WebGL color wash for landing heroes, empty states, and marketing sections: theme-aware, optional pointer follow.

items.name: shader-metal
items.title: Shader Metal
items.description: Liquid chrome, gold, or copper ribbons twisting through a studio light rig: transparent WebGL, theme-aware, with a key light that follows the pointer.

items.name: shader-sky
items.title: Shader Sky
items.description: WebGL sky for landing heroes: clear blue with drifting clouds in light, storm gray in dark, optional window-glass film.

items.name: snake-404
items.title: Snake 404
items.description: Dot-matrix 404 where every dot is food: a Nokia-style snake eats the digits, then they come back. Arrow keys, WASD, or a swipe take over.

items.name: stretchy-footer
items.title: Stretchy Footer
items.description: Dia-style rubber overscroll: rainbow aurora stretches up past the bottom, then snaps back.

items.name: typewriter
items.title: Typewriter
items.description: A real, playable typewriter in SVG: each key presses down, its typebar swings up to strike the ribbon, and the carriage steps along. Click it and type.
